thread:
rachel: Heads up - found another anchor jump in the migration guide. Clicking the link skips the H2 and lands inside the next paragraph. Seen on prod and locally.
devin: ugh, similar to the fence-id collision but this is different? can you paste the snippet?
rachel: here's the minimal markdown:

### Quick migrate
Some text here.
<!-- note: we had a frontmatter title that differs -->
[Go to Quick migrate](#quick-migrate)

rachel: the built HTML id is `quick-migrate-1` (frontmatter title slugged) but the anchor in the body is `quick-migrate`. mismatch.
samir: ah that happens when the page title and the first heading are different. mkdocs uses the page title to build the canonical id. docusaurus uses the heading. mismatch = bad.
devin: short term: change the first heading to match the frontmatter title or add explicit {#quick-migrate} to the H2.
rachel: i'll push a tiny PR to sync the heading to the title. also adding a note in the contributing doc about heading/title parity.
docs-bot: Reminder: add checklist item "heading must match frontmatter title or use explicit {#id}".
ci-bot: CI: docs build started for PR #2456
ci-bot: CI: linkcheck failed - anchor not found
ci-bot: CI: rerun after rachel's patch
ci-bot: CI: docs build and linkcheck passed ✅
samir: Filed DOCS-833 to harmonize slug source across builders. Might be a config change or a small build step to canonicalize page ids.
rachel: thanks all. merging after green.
